title: Polygon Challenge Problems Assessment
description: Show mastery of polygon side-count, angle, regularity, and convexity reasoning.

questions.question: A regular polygon has one exterior angle measuring 30 degrees. How many sides does it have? Enter just the number.
questions.explanation: The exterior angles total 360 degrees. 360 / 30 = 12 sides.

questions.question: A side of a polygon is extended. The exterior angle is 72 degrees. What is the adjacent interior angle?
questions.explanation: The adjacent interior and exterior angles form a straight angle, so 180 - 72 = 108.

questions.question: Find the interior angle sum of a decagon. Enter just the number of degrees.
questions.explanation: A decagon has 10 sides, so the interior angle sum is (10 - 2) x 180 = 1440 degrees.

questions.question: A convex pentagon has four angles measuring 100 degrees, 105 degrees, 115 degrees, and 120 degrees. What is the fifth angle?
questions.explanation: A pentagon angle sum is (5 - 2) x 180 = 540. The four known angles add to 440, so the fifth angle is 100 degrees.

questions.question: If a polygon is regular, then it is both equilateral and equiangular.
questions.explanation: Regular means all sides are equal and all angles are equal.

questions.question: Which clue proves that a polygon is non-convex?
options: It has one interior angle of 205 degrees.
questions.explanation: An interior angle greater than 180 degrees proves the polygon is non-convex.

questions.question: A regular octagon has equal exterior angles. Find one exterior angle. Enter just the number.
questions.explanation: A regular octagon has 8 equal exterior angles, so 360 / 8 = 45 degrees.

questions.question: A polygon has 6 sides, all sides equal, but its angles are not all equal. What is the best classification?
questions.explanation: Six sides make it a hexagon. Since the angles are not all equal, it is irregular.

questions.question: A diagram shows a convex quadrilateral with angles 88 degrees, 112 degrees, 75 degrees, and x. Write an equation and solve for x.
questions.explanation: A quadrilateral has interior angle sum 360 degrees. The known angles add to 275, so x = 85.

questions.question: A regular polygon has one exterior angle of 40 degrees. Name the polygon by number of sides and explain your reasoning.
questions.correctAnswer: It has 9 sides, so it is a nonagon. Since 360 / 40 = 9, the regular polygon has 9 equal exterior angles.
questions.explanation: Regular polygon exterior angles are equal and total 360 degrees. Dividing by 40 gives 9 sides.
